metadata.description: Rust skill for AI coding agents: games with Bevy, physics, audio and debug UI, recorded videos, WebAssembly effects for web pages, and Blender MCP assets.

plugins.name: playmand
plugins.description: Make your AI agent fluent in game and visual work in Rust: picks the right tool (Bevy by default, Avian physics, Kira audio, egui debug UI, Macroquad, wgpu, Rust to WebAssembly for web effects), with version-matched Bevy 0.20 APIs, tested examples, game-feel guidance, frame-by-frame video and Blender MCP assets.
